Strategy 2 on Nifty 50 — Delivery Buys and Opposite Sells (23 Oct 2023 – 26 Oct 2026)

On this page

  1. 1. The rules
  2. 2. Result (all 50 stocks added together)
  3. 3. Lesson

My best BEL lead (bel_macd_stoch_delivery_buys.md) tested on all 50 Nifty 50 stocks, every timeframe, buys and the exact opposite sells, FYERS charges only (no slippage), ₹1,00,000 per trade. Education, not investment advice. Report with per-stock tables and charges by type: ../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/STRATEGY2_N50_REPORT.md. Every trade (stock, time, price, shares, each FYERS charge, net, indicator values): reports/strategy2_n50/trades_all.csv.

1. The rules

Buy: MACD histogram bigger than the previous candle and Stoch RSI blue crosses above orange with blue below 50 → buy at that candle's close. Sell at the close of the first later candle where blue meets orange (blue ≤ orange).

Sell (exact opposite): histogram smaller than the previous candle and blue crosses below orange with blue above 50 → short at that close. Buy back at the close of the first later candle where blue meets orange (blue ≥ orange).

Shares per trade = ₹1,00,000 ÷ price, rounded down (on average ~125 shares). Same-day trades pay FYERS intraday charges, overnight buys FYERS delivery charges, overnight shorts FYERS stock-futures charges (cash shorts can't be held overnight; real futures lot sizes, often ₹5–15 lakh, are not modelled). 15-min and 30-min data start 1 Dec 2025.

All buys: 44,630 trades, 55.1 lakh shares, ₹80.2 lakh FYERS charges, net −₹69.1 lakh. All sells: 43,218 trades, 52.9 lakh shares, ₹40.1 lakh FYERS charges, net −₹46.7 lakh.

  • Every timeframe and side loses money. BEL's 4-hour profit doesn't carry over: on Nifty 50 the 4-hour buys lose ₹4.06 lakh. Only 18 of 50 stocks were profitable; the best were BSE (+₹1.03L), HINDALCO, APOLLOHOSP, BEL and JIOFIN.
  • 4-hour and daily buys do earn before charges (+₹7.6L and +₹4.8L gross; average move +0.18% / +0.22% per trade), but the 0.28% delivery charge per trade is bigger. STT alone was ₹8.2L on 4-hour buys, more than the whole gross profit.
  • The years don't agree. 4-hour buys made money in late 2023 and 2025 but lost ₹6.5L in 2026; daily buys made money in 2023–2025 and lost ₹5.6L in 2026, the falling market.
  • "Beats random" for sells is misleading. Random shorts lose a lot in a rising market, so the sells beat them while still losing money.
  • 15-min to 1-hour lose with almost every stock. 60–80% of those trades are sold the same day with a ~0% move.

3. Lesson

Strategy 2 isn't a trading system on its own: the entry has a small edge on 4-hour and daily buys, but it's smaller than FYERS delivery charges, and it reverses in falling years. BEL's result was one of the better stocks in a strong rally. If testing further, the only places with a gross edge are 4-hour and daily buys. They need trades that hold longer (a slower exit) so each move is bigger than the 0.28% charge, plus a market filter (e.g. only buy when Nifty is above its 200-day average) for years like 2026.
